name: Notice outdoor sounds
guide: Pause in an appropriate familiar outdoor spot. Notice three sounds without using your phone. If seated was selected, remain seated throughout.

name: Notice city colours
guide: From a familiar outdoor spot, notice three colours in buildings, walls or everyday objects. No photography is needed. If seated was selected, remain seated.

name: A familiar short walk
guide: Walk along a familiar appropriate path within the available activity time. Reserve the separate return phase for returning. Do not name a destination or require a purchase.

name: A seated outdoor pause
guide: Use a familiar suitable outdoor seat. If comfortable, gently move your hands and feet within your usual range, with pauses to notice your surroundings. Do not prescribe exercise or make health claims.

name: Notice ordinary details
guide: Notice shapes or patterns in familiar buildings or paving from an appropriate outdoor spot. Do not enter private property. If seated was selected, remain seated.
